16.item: castigatius eo tractantur (kept, flagged: harshly handled for that reason)
16.sense_relied_on: the tribune handles them the more harshly lest magic chants spirit them away
let us condemned nobles take refreshment before the birthday fight

16.item: pinguiores illo producamur (Greek pionoves Hs. vs pleioves cod. — kept printed)
16.sense_relied_on: is it not thy glory if we come forth the fatter
the very adjutant of the prison now believing
